sections.title: Player-facing description
sections.body: One pup stands in the moss with wet feathering along its shoulders, too-big paws, and round eyes that are trying very hard to be brave.

sections.title: Handout text
sections.body: Player-safe note: A wet-feathered strixwolf pup with oversized ears, bright frightened eyes, and paws too large for the body it has not grown into yet.

sections.title: GM truth
sections.body: No forced reveal. Let this entity disclose truth through scene context and player attention.

sections.title: GM handling
sections.body: Use to make the strixwolf scene about protection and moral choice, not monster cleanup.
